description: A REAL scrape found a scraper VM's logged-in session unusable and a human must re-login (logged out / checkpoint / 2FA). Emitted by actual user traffic (source=real_scrape) or by the 6-hourly idle canary (source=readiness_probe) — never by per-sweep polling, so every occurrence is user-affecting and actionable. needsHuman=false events (rate_limited / blocked) self-clear and are deliberately excluded.
